data.content_ref: inline:The proposed relation is misframed: the target identifies a 'misparse' of the race puzzle and predicates its refutation on a naming/identity condition (explicitly naming the current absolute second-place holder). But the causal mechanism that actually defeats the misparse is ordinal position transfer, not naming. Naming who the second-place holder is does not causally prevent the misidentification of the lead runner unless the agent also tracks that overtaking the second-place holder means assuming their position. The stated refutation condition is therefore not the operative causal mechanism; it is an epistemic labeling fix that does not, by itself, rule out the misparse, because the narrator-relative frame can still misread the lead runner even with a named second-place holder.
